title: EvaluationResult
description: Output from WASM evaluate: match list, counters, and structured errors (v1). Matched rules are in priority-descending order; engine emits effective priority (0 if rule omitted priority).

ok.description: Whether evaluation completed in a success path (see errors for structured failures).

matched.description: All rules that matched selector and conditions, priority-descending; may be empty.

evaluated.description: Count of rules considered on the evaluation path.

skipped.description: Count of skipped rules (e.g. disabled); per PRD §11.10.

priority.description: Effective priority for this rule (0 if the rule omitted priority in the ruleset).

action.description: Same Action shape as in ruleset rules.

type.description: Open string in v1; engine returns matched action data.

errorInfo.description: Same fields as error-info.schema.json; required code and message, optional rule_id and field. additionalProperties not restricted to match that schema.
